tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥannah, from the root ḥ-n-n, 'to be gracious', via the Greek Anna. Its root is Hebrew ḥ-n-n. Anna the prophetess (Luke 2:36); the mother of Mary in tradition. Anna is a Hebrew name meaning “Grace; favour”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
